'''Bug Four''' was a [[YVH 5-S Bugcruncher]] that fought alongside the [[New Jedi Order]] in the [[Battle of Kr]] against [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of the [[Gorog]] nest. Bug Four was disabled by [[Raynar Thul]] during the events on [[Kr]].
